title: violation/v1
description: A violation found from the authority's own evidence (spec 04 §3.3; 01 A7; 2019/947 Art. 18(k)), in the common envelope: published by detect on alrt.v1.<kind>.<cell5>.<violation_id> (JetStream ALRT) when it raises, updates and clears one, consumed by api (persisted in violations, every transition audited) and picture-ws. This repository owns it (M14). One violation per raise of a uspace-core alerting key: raised once, republished every second as updated while it holds with its current numbers and the samples since the last publication (C-08), and cleared once with a reason and the numbers at clearing (C-14). The envelope's captured_at is the triggering sample's placement. The judgement is uspace-core's (alerting, zones); conflict (CPA) raises are never violations (plan D5).

violation_id.description: Stable for the life of the violation: the dedupe key of api's consumer.

kind.description: height_120m (uspace-core zones.JudgeHeightLimit, the 120 m rule over the DEM), zone_incursion (a zone or dynamic restriction; USPACE presence is in_uspace, never a violation), unregistered (unidentified or unknown operator inside a PROHIBITED or REQ_AUTHORISATION zone, G-03), identification_mismatch (G-02). no_authorisation and rid_absent are later detectors (plan Q-A5, Q-A6).

zone_id.description: country/identifier of the zone judged; null for height_120m and identification_mismatch.

zone_version.description: The zone version in force; null for a dynamic restriction.

clear_reason.description: Set exactly when cleared: resolved (shown false past the hysteresis), stale, landed, source_disabled, flight_ended (uspace-core alerting.ClearReason) or reconfigured (the zone set or policy changed and the aircraft's last sample no longer raised it).

policy_version.description: The authority_policy version judged with; 0 is the documented defaults before any policy reached detect.

peak.description: The number the violation rested on at its worst: height_agl_m for height_120m (03 §1 peak_value; no stored AGL column, D-02).

detail.description: The judgement's numbers and flags as uspace-core gave them, at full precision (vertical_known, within_band, limit_not_judged, not_judged, height_agl_m, alt_hae_m, max_height_agl_m, identifier, restriction, status, identification_reason).

terrain_source.description: The DEM a height over the ground was taken from (D-05).

evidence_excerpt.description: Track samples: the window before the raise, and on an update those since the last publication (the Display Provider cache is gone in 24 h, 03 §1).
